title: epipactis bifida
intro: Epipactis bifida, commonly known as the forked helleborine, is a type of orchid species native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been studied for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis bifida include its ability to inhibit the growth of certain cancer cells and its potential as an antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of Epipactis bifida include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sterols, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
